description: This file defines the IDBContext class and related utilities for managing IndexedDB transactions, including transaction reuse, lifecycle management, and object store interactions within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: IDBContext
classes.description: Manages IndexedDB transactions, reusing transactions to minimize overhead, and provides methods to run database operations sequentially.

classes.name: ObjectStore
classes.description: Wrapper around IDBObjectStore providing methods for common database operations with logging.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Wrapper around IDBIndex for retrieving index keys with logging.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database connection after ensuring all transactions are complete.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a function with object stores in a sequential manner, handling transaction lifecycle.

methods.name: #run
methods.description: Internal method to manage transaction creation, reuse, and retries for database operations.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Waits for all pending transactions to complete and ensures database consistency.
